## Disposition and exact scope

O7b / 8400008 / AMR-083-0008 remains unresolved after two approaches (2/5 turns). This proof-only reconstructed edition records fresh acceptance of the restricted findings from both existing turn reports, with no new research turn. It does not supply the requested full-factorization reduction or an unrestricted oracle lower bound.

The complete turn-1 arguments establish squarefree-input gcd-layer support projection, identical virtual transcripts under coprime-query normalization, recoverable valuation blocks, the stated-operation invariant, and the fresh-polynomial/adaptive-degree bounds with their separate coefficient-split and success-implies-hit conditions.

The complete turn-2 arguments establish the conditional sign-blind congruence-of-squares probability, an oracle-free polynomial kernel basis for square dependencies in an already explicit batch, and the fully valued equal-norm transporter theorem. The transporter formula is gcd(c,n)=n/gcd(B,n), never an equality for c itself. Negative relation exponents require a well-defined rational-unit square relation; the subset theorem needs no negative exponents.

Polynomial relation or second-representation acquisition, worst-case bounded sampling/resources, and the complete-factorization success guarantee remain missing.

## Review, chronology, and attribution

All four reports are included byte-for-byte. Historical “preliminary/unaccepted” labels describe the earlier reconstruction state; the full fresh audit and separate acceptance record state the later restricted acceptance. The full written mathematical audit retains every argument, qualification, counterexample, and supplementary-check discussion, with three disclosed inventory/presentation edits. The original and edited audit identities are distinguished. The reviews are AI audits, not human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification.

The [Dixon congruence-of-squares method](https://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~cs812-1/dixon.pdf), established [coprime-basis work](https://research.tue.nl/en/publications/factoring-into-coprimes-in-essentially-linear-time/), and [distinct-exponent theorem](https://arxiv.org/html/2412.12558v4#S5) receive prior credit. No novelty is claimed. Public source metadata records the actual inspection history and retrieval limits, including Dixon text inspection after the earlier retrieval failure, without claiming visual inspection or acquired PDF byte identities. The original historical problem source was not recovered; the exact model is the stipulated target. The unresolved disposition is not an exhaustive current-literature certification.

## Addition-only publication boundary

Add exactly eleven files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/8400008/`: four complete reports, the full written audit, public source-inspection metadata, README, acceptance, status, provenance, and a noncircular manifest. No QUEUE.md or unrelated file changes.

The proof and full written audit stand on their mathematical arguments. Supplementary check descriptions remain in the audit, but no scripts, standalone fixtures, separate computation results or logs, third-party source documents/text/images, datasets, private sources, or private coordination material are distributed. Exact hashes and clean additive patch replay establish packaging integrity only.

Draft only. No merge, release, DOI, or auto-merge is requested.
